title: Speed of the made field: front, formation of the static mark and long range

key_results.statement: Field class, fixed contract with the source, any $N_f$, $D$, $L$: $\langle\Phi_x\rangle_\lambda=N_f|\psi(x,\lambda)|^2$ exactly, and at first order in $g_s$ $\delta\rho(x,\lambda)=2ng_s\int_0^\lambda\operatorname{Im}\mathcal U(x-x_s,s)ds$ with $\mathcal U(r,s)=\langle x_s+r|e^{-ist_f\Lambda}|x_s\rangle$.

Static mark (lowest state with the source, nondegenerate for every $g_s$) at first order: $\delta\rho_{\rm st}(r)=-(2ng_s/t_f)\Lambda^+(r)$, the leading term in $g_s\Lambda^+(0)/t_f$, which grows with $L$ for $D=1,2$.
First order, $\lambda\ge0$: $\delta\rho=\delta\rho_{\rm st}+(2ng_s/t_f)R$, $R(r,\lambda)=|X_f|^{-1}\sum_{k\ne0}\cos(k\cdot r)\cos(t_f\omega\lambda)/\omega$; on the torus $R$ does not decay.

Exact propagator: $\mathcal U(r,s)=\sum_m\mathcal U_\infty(r+Lm,s)$, $\mathcal U_\infty=e^{-2iDt_fs}\prod_\mu i^{r_\mu}J_{r_\mu}(2t_fs)$, and $|\mathcal U_\infty|\le e^{-\rho\eta(2t_fs/\rho)}$ for $2t_fs\le\rho=\|r\|_\infty$ (Kapteyn).

Exactly, for every $g_s$, $L$, $r$, $\lambda\ge0$: $|\delta\rho|\le n(e^{2|g_s|\lambda}-1)B$ and $|\delta\rho-\delta\rho^{(1)}|\le n(e^{2|g_s|\lambda}-1-2|g_s|\lambda)B\le2n(g_s\lambda)^2e^{2|g_s|\lambda}B$, $B=\max_{s\le\lambda}|\mathcal U(r,s)|\le1$; sufficient conditions for the exact response, for (8.10), (8.11), (8.14) relative to the first-order static reference (8.2) and not to the actual lowest-state mark (whose remainder is not bounded; for $D=1$, $|g_s|L/t_f>12$, (8.2) lies below $-n$ at some $r$):$|g_s|/t_f\le\varepsilon\rho^{-(p+2)}/(4e)$ for (8.7), $|g_s|t_f\Lambda_1^2\le\varepsilon s_D|r|^{1-D}/(2e)$ for (8.10) on $[\lambda_{\rm form}(\varepsilon/2),\Lambda_1]$, $|g_s|/t_f\le3\varepsilon^3|\Lambda^+(r)|^3/(8eS_2^2)$ for (8.11), $|g_s|/t_f\le8s_D\zeta^{*2}(|1-g_D(\zeta^*)|-\varepsilon)|r|^{-(D+3)}/e$ for (8.14).

Ahead of the front ($2t_f\lambda<\rho\le L/2$), at every order: $|\delta\rho|\le n(e^{2|g_s|\lambda}-1)\sum_m e^{-\rho_m\eta(2t_f\lambda/\rho_m)}$, exponentially small in $\rho$ at fixed $z=2t_f\lambda/\rho<1$ if $|g_s|/t_f<\eta(z)$; at first order the prefactor is $2n|g_s|\lambda$, and $2N_f|g_s|\lambda$ for every start.

Front along an axis, first order, $|2t_f\lambda-\rho|=O(\rho^{1/3})$, $\rho\le(1-\delta)L/2$: $\delta\rho=(ng_s/t_f)(2/\rho)^{1/3}(2/\pi\rho)^{(D-1)/2}\mathrm{Ai}((\rho-2t_f\lambda)/(\rho/2)^{1/3})P_D(2t_f\lambda)+O(\rho^{-p_D-1/3})$; its maximum over the front window is at least $b_D(n|g_s|/t_f)\rho^{-p_D}(1-o(1))$, $p_D=1/3+(D-1)/2$, $b_D=0.6749\cdot2^{1/2-D}(2/\pi)^{(D-1)/2}$; for $D=1$ the envelope maximum is $0.6749(n|g_s|/t_f)\rho^{-1/3}$.

Item 1 in the scope of the question's second note (lattice axes and $D=1$; elsewhere only absence of early arrival). Criterion: arrival when $|\delta\rho|\ge\varepsilon(n|g_s|/t_f)\rho^{-p}$, $p>p_D$; first order, $\rho\to\infty$: along the axes ($\rho\le(1-\delta)L/2$) $\lambda_a=\rho/(2t_f)+O(\rho^{1/3}(\ln\rho)^{2/3}/t_f)$, front speed along the axes $v_f=2t_f$ place labels per unit $\lambda$; in every direction ($\rho\le L/2$) $\lambda_a\ge\rho/(2t_f)-O(\rho^{1/3}(\ln\rho)^{2/3}/t_f)$, with $\rho\ge d/D$; no speed in other directions is claimed.

Behind the front, first order, $L\to\infty$ first, $|r|\to\infty$ at fixed $\zeta=|r|^2/(4t_f\lambda)$, leading order: $\delta\rho\simeq-(2ng_s/t_f)\operatorname{Re}W_D(|r|,it_f\lambda)$ with $W_D(r,\Theta)=\int_0^\Theta(4\pi s)^{-D/2}e^{-r^2/4s}ds$.

Same regime: gradient of the made field over gradient of the long-range static part $=g_D(\zeta)=\operatorname{Re}\Gamma(D/2,-i\zeta)/\Gamma(D/2)$; $1-g_1\simeq\sqrt{2\zeta/\pi}$, $1-g_2\simeq\zeta^2/2$, $1-g_3\simeq-4\zeta^{3/2}/(3\sqrt{2\pi})$ as $\zeta\to0$.

First order: the long-range part at distance $|r|$ is formed to accuracy $\varepsilon$ from $\lambda_{\rm form}=|r|^2/(4t_f\zeta_D(\varepsilon))$, $\zeta_1=\pi\varepsilon^2/2$, $\zeta_2=\sqrt{2\varepsilon}$, $\zeta_3=(3\sqrt{2\pi}\varepsilon/4)^{2/3}$ at leading order in $\varepsilon$, independent of $L$; on the torus valid up to the wrap time $(L-\rho)/(2t_f)$.

Torus, first order: the running $\lambda$-average of $\delta\rho$ tends to $\delta\rho_{\rm st}$ with error at most $(2n|g_s|/t_f)S_2/(t_f\Lambda)$, $S_2=|X_f|^{-1}\sum_{k\ne0}\omega^{-2}=O(L^{4-D})$; $\Lambda\ge S_2/(\varepsilon t_f|\Lambda^+(r)|)$ is a sufficient averaging length, with no lower bound derived; the instantaneous field does not converge.

In the class, first order, $L\to\infty$ first: for every fixed $\beta>0$ and $\varepsilon<1$, $\lambda_{\rm form}>|r|^2/(4t_f\zeta^*)>\beta|r|/t_f$ for all large $|r|$, for any fixed $\zeta^*$ with $|1-g_D(\zeta^*)|>\varepsilon$; the long-range part forms only on $\lambda\propto|r|^2/t_f$ although the front speed is finite.

Control ($D=3$ pinned harmonic lattice compressed to $M$ places per object; lowest state with the source for every $g_s$, static mark $-g_sK^{-1}e_{x_s}$). Continuum dispersion (identity): $\langle q\rangle=0$ for $\sqrt{\kappa_h}\lambda<|r|$, relative deviation $\le8.4m_Y|r|$ behind ($m_Y|r|\le1$). Lattice, along an axis, $M\to\infty$, then $L\to\infty$, then $\rho\to\infty$ at fixed $c=\sqrt{\kappa_h}\lambda/\rho>1$ and $m_Y\rho\le1$, front window excluded: $|\langle q\rangle/\langle q\rangle_{\rm st}-1|\le8.4m_Y\rho+o(1)$, $o(1)=O(\rho^{-1/2})$ for $1<c<2$; so for $m_Y\rho\le\varepsilon/16.8$ the mark forms at every fixed $c>1$, linearly in $\rho$.

Control for item 1 (hopping $\propto|x-y|^{-\alpha}$ on the ring, $\alpha>1$, nondegenerate lowest state with the source): $\delta\rho(r,\lambda_1)=ng_st_f\lambda_1^2|r|^{-\alpha}(1+O((t_f\lambda_1)^2))$ at first order, up to a relative $O(|g_s|\lambda_1)$ exactly, so the arrival time stays bounded for $p>\alpha$: no finite front speed.

Speeds: $v_f/\tau=2t_f/\tau$; for a Model D body moving along an axis, $\tau<2t_f$ is sufficient for every group velocity to be below $v_f$; level $a$ has the full-band maximum $\sqrt{m_a^2+\tau^2}-m_a$, and all its group velocities are below $2t_f$ iff $\tau^2<4t_f(t_f+m_a)$.

open_issues: The gradual switching of the question is withdrawn by its note of 2026-10-21 (A5 excludes λ-dependent contracts) and is not treated.
The size of the wrapped changes on the torus after the wrap time is not derived; instantaneous formation statements hold up to the wrap time or with L→∞ first.
Off the axes the arrival time and a front speed are not derived; the question's second note asks there only for the absence of early arrival; D=2 is not checked numerically.

At finite g_s the static mark (8.2) is given only with its expansion parameter g_sΛ⁺(0)/t_f, without a remainder bound, so the finite-coupling formation, average and failure statements are relative to the first-order reference (8.2); instantaneous formation at finite g_s is controlled by (8.18) only on finite windows; for other starts only the first-order (8.5) is derived.

In the control (8.15) the lattice transients at fixed c>1 are estimated by stationary phase, not bounded with explicit constants; the front window, directions other than the axes and the truncation errors are not bounded explicitly; its range of linear formation is ρ ≤ ε/(16.8 m_Y).
How far out the long-range mark of a moving body is formed is open, since the long-range part forms only on |r|²/t_f; moving sources are out of scope.
(8.17) rests on identifying the body's position label with the field place along an axis; the relation to the distances of 03-ilang-space is out of scope.
Whether a field with linear long-wavelength frequencies, as in (8.15), is selected by anything in the language (item 5) is not addressed.

consistency_checks.check: Static limit: the λ-average of (8.3) reproduces (8.2), i.e. (4.4) of 06-ilang-source/04-profile, and Θ→∞ in the gradient of (8.8) gives the distance dependence of (4.4) of 07-ilang-weight/04-weight-of-bond
Sum rule Σ_x δρ(x,λ)=0 at every λ, matching Σ M^(2)=0 of (4.4)
Dimensions of δρ, g_sλ, ζ, m_Y|r|, the speeds and the scales
